regions.name: timer_isr
regions.evidence: modulation-firmware-path.md: timer trace identifies page 0 ISR and CB00 TIMER1 sample. Cross-window calls remain unresolved.
summary: CB00 samples TIMER1 before control service. Normal rearm uses saved TIMER1 + 20000; fallback uses current TIMER1 + 1000.
CB17/CB20 install fetch pages 001F/002D; CB2A/CB31 restore previous selectors after the service call.

regions.name: mouse_handshake
regions.evidence: Matched scheduler trace identifies page 4B; PUSHA at 57B4 and POPA at 5811. Native driver maps F008 mouse four-nibble handshake. Region is a bounded analysis window, not an asserted function extent.
summary: PUSHA at 57B4 starts the masked section; POPA at 5811 restores flags.
Writes to F008 alternate the handshake bit while four input nibbles are read; 586F and 57C2 contain counted delay loops.

regions.name: tvf_dispatch
regions.evidence: modulation-firmware-path.md: corrected dispatcher origin 002D:8000; fast command store at 8106 and restore at 8125. Indirect dispatch is deliberately unresolved.

0x800c.evidence: Immutable instructions at 8000-800C compute 800E + 2*stage. Eight entries correspond to audited envelope stages 0-7. Other stage values remain unresolved; these are code stubs, not pointer words.

summary: Stage index selects an instruction stub at 800E + 2*stage. Annotated values 0-7 cover known envelope stages; other values remain unknown.
Fast path writes a companion command at 8106, calls cutoff calculation at 811E, and restores command 001B at 8125. Physical command semantics remain unqualified.

regions.name: cutoff_calculation
regions.evidence: modulation-firmware-path.md: exact integer replay of cutoff calculation 001F:46F1-480B. Data page 02BE must not be confused with instruction page 001F.

regions.name: initial_cutoff
regions.evidence: modulation-firmware-path.md: 002D:9270 calls cutoff calculation and writes initial cutoff companion pair. Bounded analysis window only. Expanded backward from known 9270 boundary to counter branch at 925C; both successor paths decode to tail jumps, with no guessed jump targets.
summary: Reads initial TVF counter at data[83C6 + RW86]. A zero value selects data[8306 + RW86] as current envelope value and jumps to stage continuation 8048.
A nonzero counter stores stage 2 to data[8C1E + RW84], selects data[8396 + RW86] as current envelope value, and jumps to dispatcher 8000.
Both branches call 46F1 then delay 46C2, and write D022=0 / D020=calculated cutoff. These companion writes are not exclusive to the zero-counter path.

regions.name: control_service
regions.evidence: Timer ISR CB13-CB25 selects instruction page 001F for 4000 and 002D for 8000 before calling 4000. Local direct calls lead to 43A3 and the voice loop at 43E5; cross-window destinations require context.
summary: Saves data selectors 010A/010C; selects data page 02BE at 010C, then restores selectors on return (4000-405B).
Under the active service branch, 442D calls TVF dispatcher 8000. Other calls in the voice loop remain explicitly unresolved where their regions are not covered.

regions.name: dsp_delay
regions.evidence: Immutable page 001F bytes at 46C2-46D0: fourteen NOP instructions then RET. Called by the initial-cutoff routine in the page-001F context.
summary: Fourteen NOPs followed by RET. This is an explicit firmware delay; its physical purpose and timing are not inferred from the name.

regions.name: voice_parameter_setup
regions.evidence: Direct call targets from control_service at 4415/446E etc under fetch page 001F. Bounded analysis window; no assertion of complete function extent.
summary: Selects data page 032A or 033A according to voice metadata, or 0356 in the R9D=5 branch. These writes target data selector 010A, not instruction selector 0102.
Prepares data[8A56 + RW86] from existing waveform state at 8A86 and fade state, before dispatching the next waveform-state update at 4DCA.

Eight masked dispatch cases include direction-switching ramps, wrapping ramps, a table-interpolated path, a binary-output path, a recurrence updated at phase endpoints, and bounded one-way ramps. User-facing waveform-name mapping is not established here.

0x4dca.evidence: 4DC0 masks index with 7; 4DC3 doubles it; 4DC6 adds 4DCC before indirect branch. Eight bounded index values; code stubs verified by decoding.

regions.name: amplitude_write
regions.evidence: Direct call target from control_service at 4485 etc under fetch page 001F; writes D036/D034 after channel selection and delay.
summary: Scales two per-voice words, selects channel at D040, calls delay 46C2, then writes D036=0 and D034=scaled result.

regions.name: filter_modulation_mix
regions.evidence: Control service calls 83A5 at 4422 before TVF dispatcher 442D. Under fetch 0104=002D, decoded routine writes per-voice 8516, read by cutoff calculation at 4795/47A3.
summary: Combines base words 8546/8576, contributions 8966/86F6/8846, key-related arithmetic, and scaled modulation input 8A56.
Signed depth sum uses 4077/8667/88A7/87B7, clamped to -63..63 before multiplication by 8A56.
Saturates the accumulated result to 0..32767 and writes data[8516 + RW86]; cutoff calculation consumes this word. Field names beyond this dataflow remain provisional.
